title: the launch tool's proof reads its child's cgroup through the cgroup tool
intention: The launch tool's proof asks cairn/tools/cgroup for the scoped child's cgroup instead of reading /proc/self/cgroup itself, so cairn/tools/cgroup stays the sole reader the ground loop's proof holds it to.
why: Measured 2026-11-24: cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py reds on main, its sole-reader check listing the launch tool's proof beside cairn/tools/cgroup/cgroup.py and its own proof. The reader came in with 60f16ffccd43 (PROVED), whose _READ_MAX constant spells its own read of /proc/self/cgroup. The red reds the recovery component, so every PROVED gate over recovery (e179281f6eff's first) is refused while it stands.
traces_to: Law 9 — a red on main stays red until the code is fixed; RULE 1 — the read of /proc/<pid>/cgroup is the cgroup tool's, reached through its public interface.
how: _READ_MAX puts the repo on sys.path and calls cairn.tools.cgroup.cgroup.cgroup_of() for the path it joins under /sys/fs/cgroup; no tooth changes in either proof.

clauses.claim: test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py's 'exactly one file READS /proc/<pid>/cgroup from python' check is green, its readers being cairn/tools/cgroup/cgroup.py and cairn/tools/cgroup/proofs/test_cgroup.py only
test_the_launch_tool_answers_the_launch_paths_os_questions.py's test_a_scoped_exec_runs_under_the_memory_max_passed stays green, the child reading memory.max 104857600

decisions.text: D1: _READ_MAX (line 142) becomes a %-built string that does sys.path.insert(0, <repo>), imports cgroup_of from cairn.tools.cgroup.cgroup, and joins its answer under /sys/fs/cgroup; the parent child string formats it with %r as today.

D2: the two proofs declare 4aafe74aff69 in PROVES (clause 1 the ground loop's sole-reader tooth, clause 2 the launch proof's scoped-exec tooth), and the sole-reader tooth prints its reader list on its own line, so the printed tooth name is the declared name.

out: the ground loop proof's teeth and sanctioned readers

measured.how: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py in the house at e0eb67251

measured.saw: the hollow refused at HEAD: the sole-reader tooth's sealed name carried its detail ('... from python  — readers: [...]'), so the declared name was never green
measured.how: bin/cairn test --hollow 4aafe74aff69 --seal, twice; then teeth_printed over the line

unknowns: whether the scoped child's interpreter finds cairn without the repo on sys.path (assumed not; the child string inserts it)
